title: owenloop reference-mode order v1
description: The frozen order packet emitted by the engine. Static instructions resolve separately from the defDigest reference.

defDigest.description: Opaque non-empty definition reference; the resolver boundary may inject values that are not a fixed hex digest.

spec.description: Opaque worker configuration. The engine carries keys and values through without interpreting them.

x.description: Opaque extension data carried through without engine interpretation.

consumes.description: Open artifact-path keys mapped to captured input handles.

consumedFingerprint.description: Open artifact-path keys mapped to non-negative input versions captured at claim time.

version.description: Target version this claim's next successful producer commit lands (committed version + 1), issued by the engine inside the claim transaction. A producer signs this version in its submission proof and the downstream consumer checks the proof against it.

capabilities.description: The composed routing capabilities this order was offered under: each authored step capability, suffixed ':<modifier>' where a modifier applied. A snapshot of the offer — a claimed order is never recomposed.

modifier.description: The modifier that composed 'capabilities'. Normally the run's modifier; on an escalated re-offer, the escalating step's target. Absent means the order was offered on bare capabilities.

escalated.description: Present only when 'modifier' is the step's escalation target rather than the run's own modifier — a recovery re-offer after escalation.after judgment rejections. Absent on every ordinary offer; never false.
